**Native build of 1.2.1.** This is everything in 1.2.1, with the same native pieces as 1.2.0-beta.2.native.1. It's for test servers only, and it's offered only on the **Native** channel under **System, Updates** (or with `install.sh --native`). See [Native builds](https://github.com/MattA-Official/mc-panel/blob/native-1.2.1-native.1/docs/updating.md#native-builds).

**Faster disk use.** **System, Disk** measures with `flytower-du`, the small Rust program shipped in the release, and falls back to the old way if it's ever missing or fails. The system helper starts through `bin/flytower-agent`, ready for the Rust agent in a later native build.

Testing: update from 1.2.0-beta.2.native.1 on the Native channel and check that join and leave notifications arrive on a 26.x server, that **System, Disk** shows the same figures as before, and that **Go back to** 1.2.0-beta.2.native.1 still works.
